name: Stonewake

attributes.description:
A living stone rests at the heart of this wand.

Living Bark: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to ready a ward for 4 seconds. Your next direct hit loses up to 6 HP damage against creatures or 3 against players, within the shared ward limit. Damage over time and hits fully absorbed by mana shield do not consume it. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
